# Home Ed Resource

> A list of home education websites that a UK home ed family have actually used, with a note on who each one suited and when we last checked it. Free things first, paid things underneath.

One UK home educating household keeps this list. Nobody pays to be on it,
there are no affiliate links, and every entry carries the date it was last
opened and checked. Entries that stop being useful are removed rather than
left up.

Region: United Kingdom
Contact: via https://homeedresource.co.uk/#suggest
Entries: 2
Last updated: 2026-09-18

## Free — genuinely free, not a trial that turns into a bill

- [iDEA](https://idea.org.uk): Little online modules about computers, money and work skills. You earn badges as you go, and they add up to a Bronze, Silver or Gold award. Handy if you like having something to show for the term. (Good from about 8 · Do it in any order · Fine on a phone. Last checked 2026-09-18.)
- [Do Revision](https://dorevision.com): Revision questions and a plan for what to do next. The plan is the bit we found useful — without a school timetable, someone has to decide what gets revised today, and this does it for you. (Teens · GCSE · Free bit is usable. Last checked 2026-09-11.)

## Paid — nothing here yet, and that's on purpose

- We're trying a couple of paid things at the moment. We'd rather use them for a term before telling you to spend money on them, so this bit stays empty for now.
